description: AION 2 Guide text for the Equipment and Crafting sections that no other record holds (The Aetherium Guide, phase 3, 18 Oct 2026): pets, wings, titles, the five professions, how a craft works, gathering and the crafted gear ladder. Facts in our own words, each with a status: confirmed, reported, disputed (sources disagree), pending (nothing confirms it yet) or opinion (what players say, never a rule). Crafting facts are summarised from docs/CRAFTING-RESEARCH.md (its statuses kept). Enhancement, grades and where gear drops live in enhancement.json, grades.json and gear-sources.json; the Guide pages read those directly.

records.label: Gear slots
records.lede: Your Daeva wears a weapon and a guard, seven armour pieces, nine accessories with the belt and amulet, two runes and five Arcana.

groups.name: Weapon and guard
groups.text: The weapon comes first in every plan, then the guard.

groups.name: Armour
groups.text: Helm, pauldrons, breastplate, greaves, gloves, boots and cloak.

groups.name: Belt and amulet
groups.text: They enhance with their own scrolls, to +10 at every grade.

groups.name: Runes
groups.text: Runes enhance their own way. How is not confirmed yet.

groups.name: Arcana
groups.text: Card-like items from Transcendence that raise item level and skill levels.

facts.text: The official character data lists every worn item with its slot, grade and enhance level. A slot shows only when something is worn there.
The game keeps 3 loadouts each for looks, armour and skills.
Your item level is the sum the official data sends with your character. Content gates (Expedition entry and so on) ask for it.

provenance.note: Miguel: the game has 3 loadouts each for looks, armour and skills.

records.label: Pets
records.lede: Pets are collected, not just worn. Every pet you collect and level gives a small permanent bonus, even when it is not out.

facts.text: The collection is shared by every character on the same server.
A monster pet comes from its souls: 5 to collect it at level 1, 30 in all for level 2, 105 in all for level 3.
A pet's Source tab names the monsters that drop its souls, where they are, and any chest or shop that sells it.
Each pet at level 3 adds 1,000 EXP to its genus board, and genus Insight rolls add more stats.
Special pets give no owned stat bonus.
Ascension Trial pays Growth Pet Chests, materials for raising pets.

records.generaNote: Per pet at level 3, for the 200 monster pets on the global servers.

records.label: Wings
records.lede: Wings work like pets: the more you own, the more Flight Power you have, worn or not.

facts.text: Flight Power rises as you collect more wings. Owned wings give their collection effect even when not worn.
Every Expedition can drop a set of Sealed Wings, a Substance Morph material. Sealed Wings can also be morphed into Enhance Stones, with a weekly limit per server.
The weekly limit on morphing Sealed Wings into Enhance Stones.
Sealed Dungeons give materials for wings and statues.
The Nightmare shop sells Conqueror Wings for 20,000 Phantasmal Fragments and Nightmare Wings for 160,000, once each.
The last main quest, Daeva Trapped in a Nightmare, opens at a full Daeva Gauge and gives the Unique Ultimate Daeva Wings.

records.label: Titles
records.lede: Titles give stats. You show one title by name, and you equip title effects for their stats.

facts.text: The official character data lists the titles you own and the title effects you have equipped.
Some Sealed Dungeons give a title with stats the first time you clear them.
After the Fire Temple final boss, a hidden achievement gives the title Kromede Will Remember That, which raises PvE attack.
The last main quest gives the Unique title Encountering Zikel's Core.
A full list of titles and how to get each one.

records.label: The five professions
records.lede: One character can learn all five crafts. Each one levels on its own, and every craft you try gives proficiency, success or not.

professions.name: Blacksmithing
professions.makes: Greatswords, longswords, daggers, maces and Guards

professions.name: Armorsmithing
professions.makes: Helm, pauldrons, breastplate, gloves, greaves, boots and cloak

professions.name: Handicrafting
professions.makes: Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, bows and staffs

professions.name: Alchemy
professions.makes: Spellbooks, orbs, potions, serums, scrolls, Manastones and Soulstones

professions.name: Cooking
professions.makes: Buff food and drinks, no gear

facts.text: Some sites use other names (Weaponsmithing, Tailoring, Jewelcrafting). These are the names in the global client menu.
Crafting is free to use. Membership gates the Market, not crafting.
Crafting opens at about Lv 10, at the Crafting Table in each town's crafting area.
Proficiency runs from 1 to 50 as a Novice, then on to 100 after a promotion quest.
Every craft gives proficiency, success or not.
Before Lv 35, gather all the time and level your crafting, so that by the time you are proficient you can farm enough material to succeed.

players.text: Handicrafting first: accessories fill five slots and gain most from the extra Soul Binding line on crafted gear.
Alchemy first, gathering Odyle alongside, then the weapon and the Guard. Good Manastones sell well.
Armorsmithing last for PvE; crafted armour may matter more in PvP.
Cooking is cheap and useful early.

provenance.note: Miguel, in game: before Lv 35, gather and level crafting (armour, weapons, food, jewellery) so you can farm enough material to succeed.

facts.text: Two gauges, success and failure, fill turn by turn. The first one full decides the result.
A failure uses up all the materials. Being hit or moving during a craft counts as a failure.
The higher your proficiency above the recipe, the better the chance. The recipe window shows the chance.
Gear crafts never reach 100%, except recipes that use a Core: those always succeed and give a bound item.
A successful gear craft can trigger a combo that gives the Splendent version, one grade higher.

records.label: Gathering
records.lede: Gathering (essence extraction) feeds every craft. Gather as you quest: it levels at the same time.

types.name: Herbs
types.examples: Aria and Targena (Elyos), Azpha and Calendula (Asmodian)

qualities.text: Most materials come in four qualities: Base, Fine, Pure and Radiant. A recipe asks for the matching quality.

facts.text: Each node has 2 to 4 uses, with a lockout per spot. Gathering has its own success and failure gauges.
Verteron and Altgard have the most nodes. Odyle is also found in Chaotic Lower Reshanta.
Odyle floats in the air near camps, towns and points of interest. You need wings, and running out of wing stamina stops the extraction.
Raw Leather comes from certain monsters only, never from nodes.
Each profession's merchant sells the additives: Solvent, Catalyst, Spiritstones, Glass Bottles, Abrasive, Sandpaper and condiments.
Gathering skills include Search (shows nodes on the map), Bountiful Harvest (double yield) and Appraiser (higher quality). Resetting them costs 50,000 Kina.
Whether gathering opens from the start or at Lv 45.
Material Conversion turns a higher quality into a lower one, never up.

records.label: The crafted gear ladder
records.lede: Crafted gear climbs a ladder. Each step is made from the Splendent version of the step below, so you move up only with a combo.

steps.name: Base
steps.example: Orichalcum Greatsword; Yggdrasil or Asvata Bow

steps.name: Dragon Lord
steps.example: True Dragon Lord (Elyos), Star Dragon Lord (Asmodian)

steps.name: Transfer step 1
steps.example: White Dragon Lord, Dark Dragon Lord

steps.name: Transfer step 2
steps.example: Wise Dragon Lord, Ebony Dragon Lord

facts.text: A result that is not Splendent is a dead end: wear it or sell it.
Dragon Lord gear needs proficiency 55, is Unique, and has one more Soul Binding line than dungeon drops (5 lines against 3 or 4).
Guards need proficiency 5, 20, 35 and 60; boots and cloaks 10, 25, 40 and 60. Bracelets combine three of the bracelet below.
Accessory bases: rings from Sapphire, earrings from Diamond, necklaces from Ruby.
Transfer crafting keeps the base item's enhance, amplification and Soul Binding levels and binds the new item to you. If it fails you keep the transfer piece; the other materials are lost.
Whether the White and Wise (Dark and Ebony) Dragon Lord steps are in the global client yet.
The Dragon Lord and transfer steps use Wrathful Mind, Will and Ego. Expeditions drop them: Mind from Krao Cave up, Will from Urugugu Canyon up, Ego from Fire Temple and Ferocious Horn Den.
A crafted weapon adds PvE damage.
